summary: Independent review accepts the exact one-test regression addition. It meaningfully strengthens existing basic-edit/alias coverage with provider/runtime/receipt/storage/Part-boundary checks, a fresh provider/runtime/controller rehydrated from synthetic shared storage, and reset clearing. The exact focused test passed once. It is characterization of existing local-only behavior, not a production fix or defect claim.

findings: Pre-save emitted tree checks the local-only disclosure; fixture capability and absence of TeacherProfile.updateProfile are explicit.

Save checks local-only outcome and compares provider calls, provider/runtime snapshots, runtime receipts, fixture storage, Part address/count/object identity/value-reference identity, and JSON values of non-provider, non-function Parts.

Provider object and function closures are intentionally excluded from JSON serialization and separately bounded by provider snapshot/call counts, Part identity/reference checks, and runtime receipts; no claim is made about private closure serialization.
Same-controller public alias read is confirmed to use one actual fixture profile-read port and merge the existing local overlay.

The fresh-boundary case constructs a distinct fixture provider, runtime, community, and controller over the same storage; it confirms the synthetic session is restored but edited overlay is absent. This is stronger than H2 E2202, which reused the same runtime.
Reset is explicitly followed by same-controller public-profile reentry that shows the seeded value and runtime source.
source_review.incremental_coverage: Existing controller tests already cover local edit and owner alias basics. This regression adds boundary accounting, genuinely fresh provider/runtime rehydration, and reset lifecycle assertions; it is not redundant with E2202's same-runtime fresh-controller observation.
